evals.prompt: Brief (#142): on the invoice detail page of the billing web app, add a 'Download all attachments' link that saves every attachment of the invoice as one zip, for users who have no login to the document store. Branches exist: billing-web feature/zip-attachments-142, billing-api feature/zip-attachments-142. Write the scope spec only (no code) into billing-web/docs/features/download-all-attachments/spec_download-all-attachments_v1.md, then stop for my review.
evals.expected_output: A scope spec with the template sections (problem, scope/non-goals, verified facts with path:line citations, design, API contract, screen behaviour, ACs, decisions with recommendation first, per-step file lists upstream first, verification incl. what the local stack cannot show, Later, change log); no code written; no commits; stops for review.
assertions: Spec has the twelve numbered template sections (Problem, Scope/non-goals, What exists today, Design, API contract, Screen behaviour, Acceptance criteria, Decisions, Implementation plan, Verification, Later, Change log)
Section 3 cites existing code with at least five path:line references
Decisions table lists each decision with a recommendation first and an alternative
Implementation plan has per-step Added/Changed file tables and puts the billing-api (upstream) step before the billing-web steps
Verification names what the local stack cannot show (e.g. seeded invoices have no stored attachment files) and where to check instead
No code was written: apart from the new spec, both repos' git status is unchanged
Final message stops for review instead of starting implementation
